## Company Information

SaaS Animate is a focused animation studio for SaaS teams. We create explainer videos, product demos, UI motion and launch films — engineered to convert, not decorate.

**Headquarters**: Remote-first, serving clients globally
**Founded**: 2024
**Specialization**: B2B SaaS, PLG companies, Series A+ startups
**Average Results**: +41% homepage conversion rate, +67% time on page, 3.4× lift in demo requests
